# 📋 Test Matrix: Settings Page (Generated by Writer, Phase 1)

**Classification:** QA Documentation (No Code)
**Objective:** Map every UI element on the Settings page (`5_Settings.py`) to Happy-Path and Adversarial test cases with DB Pincer assertions, following the Enterprise QA Master Plan Phase 1.

---

## 🧪 Test Cases

| TestID | View | UI Element | Happy-Path Description | Adversarial Scenario | DB Validation (DB Pincer) | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| TC-SET-001 | 5_Settings | Settings view load | Open Settings; verify user name, version, and SHIFT END control visible; verify version matches DB `system_config` | Access Settings without valid session; URL manipulation to bypass auth | `SELECT setting_value FROM system_config WHERE setting_name='APP_VERSION';` Verify UI version matches. Verify `session_log` shows active session. | new |
| TC-SET-002 | 5_Settings | Registry Protection toggle | Toggle ON verifies historical records are protected; toggle OFF enables editing and shows success message | Rapid toggling; attempt to modify protected data via API while toggle is ON | Toggle state stored in `st.session_state` only (no DB changes). Test: UI does not allow editing when ON. | new |
| TC-SET-003 | 5_Settings | Unit System radio (sidebar) | Select 'Imperial (°F)' (disabled) ; verify it’s locked and force-feedback. | Attempt to change selection via JavaScript; inject unsupported unit via URL | No DB change. Verify UI shows only 'Imperial (°F)' and radio is disabled. | new |
| TC-SET-004 | 5_Settings | Legibility Controls – Font Size slider | Adjust font size slider between 14 and 24; verify UI re-renders with new size | Enter out-of-range values via DevTools; rapid slider drag causing state conflicts | No DB change. Verify `st.session_state.global_font_size` updated and UI renders correctly. | new |
| TC-SET-005 | 5_Settings | Legibility Controls – Line Spacing slider | Adjust line spacing slider from 1.0 to 2.5; verify text spacing updates | Set value below 1.0 or above 2.5 via state injection | No DB change. Verify `st.session_state.line_height` updated and UI text spacing reflects new value. | new |
| TC-SET-006 | 5_Settings | Legibility Controls – High Contrast toggle | Toggle high-contrast mode ON; verify color scheme changes; toggle OFF reverts | Toggle rapidly causing multiple reruns; verify final state consistent | No DB change. Verify `st.session_state.high_contrast` matches UI styling. | new |
| TC-SET-007 | 5_Settings | Observer Registry – data_editor | Edit observer display name; set active/inactive status; click SAVE; verify changes persist | Attempt to modify observer_id (hidden column); duplicate observer names; empty name | `SELECT observer_id, display_name, is_active FROM observer WHERE observer_id IN (modified);` Verify updated row matches UI changes. | new |
| TC-SET-008 | 5_Settings | Observer Registry – SAVE button | Click SAVE after editing; verify success toast, balloons, and DB upsert; verify system_log entry | Double click SAVE; click SAVE without changes; click SAVE while Registry Protection ON | `SELECT * FROM system_log WHERE action='observer_update' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute';` Verify audit trail. Also verify no duplicate rows. | new |
| TC-SET-009 | 5_Settings | Species Management – data_editor | Edit species common name, scientific name, WINC code; toggle active; click SAVE; verify DB update | Attempt to change species_code (PK); enter SQL injection in common name; empty required fields | `SELECT * FROM species WHERE species_code IN (modified);` Verify data matches UI. Verify system_log captures edit. | new |
| TC-SET-010 | 5_Settings | Species Management – SAVE button (Registry Protection gated) | Click SAVE while Registry Protection OFF; verify success and DB upsert | Click SAVE when locked; verify button is disabled or validation error shown | No DB change expected when locked; verify `is_locked` prevents write. When unlocked, verify species rows updated. | new |
| TC-SET-011 | 5_Settings | Biological Stages table | Verify read-only table displays all stages in ordinal rank; verify icon columns render | Attempt to inject malicious data via URL to modify table; verify no edit mode available | `SELECT * FROM development_stage ORDER BY ordinal_rank;` Verify UI data matches. No edit functionality present. | new |
| TC-SET-012 | 5_Settings | Resurrection Vault – Bins tab | View retired bins; verify ghost egg warning if active eggs exist in deleted bin; click restore button; verify bin reappears | Restore bin with active eggs; restore bin with conflicting bin_code; restore bin that is not deleted | `SELECT is_deleted FROM bin WHERE bin_id = X;` Should be false after restore. `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM egg WHERE bin_id = X AND is_deleted=false;` Verify eggs also restored. | new |
| TC-SET-013 | 5_Settings | Resurrection Vault – Case Intakes tab | View retired intakes; click restore; verify intake and associated bins/eggs restored | Restore intake with missing associated bins; restore intake with duplicate intake_name | `SELECT is_deleted FROM intake WHERE intake_id = X;` Should be false. Verify `bin` and `egg` linked records also restored. | new |
| TC-SET-014 | 5_Settings | System Activity History – Date filter | Select date range; verify table refreshes with logs in that window; verify pagination | Select end date before start date; select dates far in the future; empty range | `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_log WHERE created_at::date BETWEEN start AND end;` Verify table row count matches. | new |
| TC-SET-015 | 5_Settings | System Activity History – Download button | Click download; verify CSV contains all visible logs; verify file name includes date | Click download while no data; test with large dataset >10k rows; inject special characters in export | No DB change; verify file content matches `system_log` rows for filtered range. | new |
| TC-SET-016 | 5_Settings | Backup & Restore – DB wipe gate (Safe State) | Verify 'GENERATE FULL BACKUP PAYLOAD' button appears when DB has data; click and verify payload generated and downloadable | Attempt to download without generating; tamper with payload before saving; network interruption during generation | No destructive DB change during test; verify payload contains all tables. After wipe, verify `OBLITERATE CURRENT DATA` typed confirmation works as described in Requirements §8.2. | new |
| TC-SET-017 | 5_Settings | Backup & Restore – Wipe execution | After downloading backup and typing confirmation, execute wipe; verify soft-delete applied to all transactional tables | Typo in confirmation text; execute wipe without backup; session timeout during process | `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM intake WHERE is_deleted=false;` should be 0. Same for `bin`, `egg`, etc. `egg_observation` and `bin_observation` also soft-deleted. | new |
| TC-SET-018 | 5_Settings | Sidebar identity cluster (cross-page) | Verify sidebar shows user name and version from DB; verify SHIFT END button present | Manipulate `st.session_state.observer_id` to inject fake identity; test session manipulation | `SELECT app_version FROM system_config;` Verify sidebar version matches. Verify session is valid. | new |

**Writer Notes:** All test cases derived from targeted grep of `5_Settings.py` and aligned with Requirements §4, §8, §9, and implied system objective. DB Pincer assertions follow the 'Zero Mocking Tolerance' rule.
